Application process

## How does this work?

[Apply now](https://www.ajuniorvc.com/apply) and get a response in

43.4

Hrs

### 01\. Application

We take away the friction of starting to fundraise through a 3 minute application. We reply with yes/no within 48 hours.

### 02\. Data Driven Evaluation

If we like your application, we share a detailed form for your business. Our partnership reads every form.

### 03\. Rapid Decision

The final step is a call with the partnership. The decision to invest is made within a week of the call.

Perks & Benefits

## What do we offer?

### Standard Terms

Each company that is accepted gets a standard offer

### Partnership Support

Every founder is supported by a partner with extensive investing and/or operating experience

### Founders Compass

Our continuous support system that helps founders increase their odds of success

### India’s Largest Startup Community

Selected startups get visibility to a highly engaged tech audience of 500,000+, helpful with hiring, customers, fundraising.

Hear from people like you

Fundraising is usually a long process. Endless meetings, painstaking diligence, and legal back-and-forth drag founders away from what matters most: solving problems for customers. Couldn't have asked for a better start to this journey as first-time founders!

AJVC has been one of the most hands-on and helpful partners in our journey. The process moved quickly -we had a term sheet in under two weeks - but what stood out even more was how thoughtful and sharp the team was right from the first conversation.

We feel lucky to have AJVC on our cap table. If you’re looking for an early investor who brings energy, clarity, and skin in the game, this is the team you want backing you.

For any founder looking to learn how to execute well, the AJVC application process itself is a valuable lesson in itself. It's been delightful and educational experience from start to finish. Being a part of AJVC has unquestionably been one of the best decisions we’ve made on our startup journey.







Saurabh



















We first heard about AJVC on LinkedIn and applied on their website the very same day. To our surprise, we received a positive response the next day for a second-round discussion. By Day 5, we had our final call with Aviral, and by Day 11, the term sheet was in our inbox. While the speed of investment was impressive, the real value began post-investment. While many VCs do reviews to track progress, AJVC does it to help you make progress- with mentorship at every step.







Vivek



















AJVC’s processes handled screening, modelling, and paperwork almost in the background; two days after our first call, a clean term sheet hit our inbox. Speed alone, though, isn’t what won us over. Aviral takes the time to understand the quirks of our business before weighing in. His questions are thoughtful - sometimes uncomfortably sharp - yet always aimed at helping us find the right answer rather than defending a fixed thesis. Available 24/7 for his founders, he’s always replied to our odd-hour pings with quick voice notes and pointed ideas.







Akshat



















AJVC’s speed of evaluation and decision-making is what truly stands out. They’re fast and super process-driven — which makes you put your thoughts down and think through while in the application process. They really get what it means to be at pre-seed - the unknowns and the kind of assistance that’s actually useful at this stage. The regular support post-investment in terms of planning, prioritizing, or just having someone to bounce ideas with is very helpful.







Avinash



















We joined AJVC as first-time founders with more uncertainty than answers, yet Aviral never made us feel inexperienced. Every question, no matter how basic, was met with a calm and patient explanation that lifted our confidence. He has also built an environment where we can share any issue without editing ourselves. We can raise anything from hiring gaps to compliance nitpicks and trust that his first instinct is to help. We know the goal is to find a fix, not to judge. This keeps problems small and solvable.







Bhavesh



















AJVC has been one of the most founder-friendly investors we’ve come across, both in speed and in depth.

What stood out was how deeply they went into our industry and competitors in a very short time.
